items.stem: Explain why the balance in the cash book may differ from the balance on the bank statement.
items.answer: Timing differences (unpresented cheques, outstanding lodgements); items the business does not know about until it receives the statement (charges, standing orders, credit transfers, dishonoured cheques); errors by the business or the bank.

items.stem: Explain why a bank statement shows a positive bank balance as a credit.
